title: Mixed Event — Awakening Beat

meta.Outline: Kohane has steadily built up experience, including performing solo at events. An, Akito and Toya all acknowledge her efforts, but Kohane herself doesn't seem confident. An and the others try to get Kohane to believe in herself.

rows.Line: Live House

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: And the winner is... Vivid BAD SQUAD!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Yeah! Way to go, Vivid BAD SQUAD!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: They just keep getting better... Battling against Arata probably gave them a huge boost too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: There were so many other good teams today, but I'm glad we pulled through in the end.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! But we did it, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Still, there's a lot we need to work on. We're doing a debrief right after this.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I agree. Some things are still bothering me as well.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Then let's head over to my place!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay!
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm home!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hello!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Hey, you're back.
Based on your mood, I'm guessing your event went well?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, it went perfectly!
Everybody else was really good too, so we learned a lot.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
That's great.
And the usual for you guys, I'm guessing?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yes. Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Then let's begin our debrief.
About our first song...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That leaves the finale for our third song. It felt as if the audience cheering speeds up our tempo more than we'd like...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, I totally get what you mean. It's like they're making us follow their rhythm instead of our own...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And we gotta stick to our own rhythm if we want to sound as good as we possibly can.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I have a habit of rushing ahead during the second half too, so I'll make sure to keep practicing!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, maybe I can work on that while I practice the song I'll be doing for that solo event that's coming up...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The same habit sort of applies to that song too...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Mind if we talk a little more about that?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? Sure, what is it?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane, you've been participating in all these solo events to get more on-stage experience, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. I've been learning so much, and I think they're really helping me stay much calmer during our shows compared to before.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You've even learned how to become quite the crowd-pleaser. I have to say, it's very impressive.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I know, right? I feel the same way.
That's why...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Instead of doing events by yourself, Kohane, why don't we use that time to practice more as a team or enter into more team events?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm with her. You've got plenty of experience already, so it's probably good to start working more as a team now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: See what I mean?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, okay...
...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hm? Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It's just that... I'm a little worried...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You're worried?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes. I've gotten used to performing on stage, but my singing still isn't at your guys' level yet. That's why I'm wondering if it's okay for me to just stop like this...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, Kohane, you're such a modest girl.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You keep saying, I'm not up to your guys' level yet. But I think you already are.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So you don't need to worry so much!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh...
Thanks, An.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: In her case, this might be the right way to go...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I think so too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay, then we can start practicing more as a team...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's keep kicking butt, together!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But is it okay if I still sing in next week's event? I sort of already promised that I'd go...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Of course!
Oh, mind if we come and watch...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I still haven't gotten a chance to see you on stage, Kohane. I really wanna see how you do up there and stuff, you know?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Are you sure? Knowing that you're in the crowd...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Girl, you'll be fine!
Show us what you're really made of!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We'll all be there rooting for you!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
We...?
All of us are going?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Well, duh.
We oughta be there to see the results of all of her hard work.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I'd like to go too.
Singing and performing is important, but we may also be able to learn something from watching.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Fine, whatever...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: On one condition, Kohane. Give it everything you've got.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I... I will!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm a little nervous, but I'll do my best to make it a good show...!
Kohane's Room

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No! I did it again there.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
One more time!
Focus...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay. That sounded much better...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (If I can sing like this, then I should be okay for next week's event.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (An even said that I'm singing as well as everyone else is now, so I'm sure everything will be fine...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Hehe. I feel like I'm dreaming. I never imagined myself being told that I'd rise up to their level considering how good they already were...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Am I really singing as well as they say I am...?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I know I've made improvements here and there, but I'm still not sure about being able to sing that well...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (No, now's not the time for that...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I need to keep practicing while I still can...)
The day of the event
A small live house

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (There's a lot of people here again today...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I feel more comfortable about performing, but it's still hard not to get a little nervous before my turn.)

rows.Speaker: Staff A
rows.Line:
Hey, Kohane!
You're in today's event, right? Looking forward to seeing you up there!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, hello.
Thank you for having me again.

rows.Speaker: Staff B
rows.Line: I heard from someone that this is gonna be your last solo event. Is that true?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Y-Yes, it is.

rows.Speaker: Staff A
rows.Line: What? Really?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes. I'm hoping to spend more time practicing with my team.

rows.Speaker: Staff A
rows.Line: Yeah, I get it. Especially since you guys are trying to surpass RAD WEEKEND...

rows.Speaker: Staff B
rows.Line: It's good to have your priorities straight, but I am pretty bummed to hear this. I mean, you've been getting better and better with each show.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I... I'm so sorry...

rows.Speaker: Staff B
rows.Line:
No, don't say that!
We'll just have to cheer for you and the rest of Vivid BAD SQUAD from now on!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you very much...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, I need to go soon...!

rows.Speaker: Staff A
rows.Line: Yeah, go get 'em!

rows.Speaker: Staff A
rows.Line: She's so humble. Most kids that can sing like her would let everything get to their head, but not her...

rows.Speaker: Staff B
rows.Line:
I know, right?
It's making me wonder how she can be so humble or modest.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Alright, we're here!
Just in time too!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It looks like Azusawa won't be up until later. We can sit and watch here in the meantime.

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line:
First up is FLASH!
Let's see what they have in store for us!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (It's started...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (All the performers on Vivid Street are so incredible.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I need to do my best to keep up with them...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, it's Kohane!
Go get 'em, girl!

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line:
Next is one of our biggest rising stars!
Give it up for Vivid BAD SQUAD's Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Spectator
rows.Line: Alright! It's Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Spectator
rows.Line: She's been getting better and better lately. It's hard not to come and see her.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Everyone's got pretty high expectations for Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I can see that, but it's no wonder considering how good she's become.

rows.Speaker: A Mysterious Man
rows.Line: Vivid BAD SQUAD...

rows.Speaker: A Mysterious Man
rows.Line: That means... She must be An's...
song00005_off_f

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
So far so good...
She's off to a smooth start.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, she isn't holding back at all. She's really giving it everything she's got.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You're the best, Kohane!!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
*Huff*... *Huff*...
Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I, um... I'll be committing more time to my team, Vivid BAD SQUAD, from now on and won't be able to sing by myself like this anymore...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But our dream as a team is to surpass RAD WEEKEND, so I hope we can count on you for your support!

rows.Speaker: A Mysterious Man
rows.Line:
So that's how it is...
This is the path he chose?

rows.Speaker: A Mysterious Man
rows.Line: But it's still not enough...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Phew. I'm glad everything went so well...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An and the others are here, so maybe I can pop in and say hi before they announce the results.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
They should be...
Eek...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I-I'm so sorry! I didn't mean to bump into...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(*Gasp*...!
H-He's so tall...!)

rows.Speaker: A Mysterious Man
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry about that.
I was blocking your path, wasn't I?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Uh, no! I should've been more careful too...!

rows.Speaker: A Mysterious Man
rows.Line: Hm? Aren't you Kohane? Weren't you just singing up there...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Y-Yes, I'm Kohane Azusawa. I was a part of today's event.

rows.Speaker: A Mysterious Man
rows.Line:
I knew it!
You gave us a pretty good song!

rows.Speaker: A Mysterious Man
rows.Line: I'm betting that you won't find many other girls that can sing like you do.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? I, uh... I'm not that...!

rows.Speaker: A Mysterious Man
rows.Line: But you're still... You know?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: A Mysterious Man
rows.Line: Your team's trying to surpass RAD WEEKEND, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Y-Yes, we are!!

rows.Speaker: A Mysterious Man
rows.Line: Then you still don't have what it takes. You need to broaden your horizons more...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: A Mysterious Man
rows.Line:
Anyways, see you later.
And good luck.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: W-Wait... Please!

rows.Speaker: A Mysterious Man
rows.Line: Hm? Yeah?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You said that I don't have what it takes. What am I missing?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It's just... I'm not sure that's something I can figure out on my own even if someone tells me that flat out...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I want to do what I can to make that dream...!

rows.Speaker: A Mysterious Man
rows.Line:
Well...
I'd say you're lacking...

rows.Speaker: A Mysterious Man
rows.Line: Commitment.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: A Mysterious Man
rows.Line: You sing well and have a good voice, but I've got this inkling that you haven't fully committed to yourself yet, you know...?

rows.Speaker: A Mysterious Man
rows.Line: Right now, you have a personality that might let you climb higher...

rows.Speaker: A Mysterious Man
rows.Line: But if you learn to fully commit to yourself, I have a feeling that you'll turn into something we've never seen before.

rows.Speaker: A Mysterious Man
rows.Line:
That's all I had to say.
See you later, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Kohane! You did great!
That was such an amazing song too!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Hm...?
Is something bothering you, Azusawa?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, why do you look so sad?
You blew everybody out of the water today.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Um, well...
There's something that I'm trying to figure out...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Would it be okay if I asked you guys about it...?
Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You seriously got all worked up over something someone in the crowd said?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: How many times has this already happened to us? Quit giving them attention that they don't deserve.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I know, but...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What did this person tell you?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That I lack commitment, I think...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Commitment?
What did he mean by that?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Not committing enough to yourself, huh...? I see...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It makes more sense if you put it that way.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
This is just my guess...
But I think he meant that you need to be more confident in yourself.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: More confident...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. You have this incredible talent for singing, Azusawa, but haven't fully realized it yet.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I believe that's what that person meant by what they said.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, I see. I should be more proud of what I do like you guys.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But it also isn't bad to not have that sort of confidence in yourself.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: In the beginning, I thought us not having enough confidence in ourselves was our biggest weakness...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But I'm starting to think that it might actually be our biggest strength now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I agree with Akito.
Despite any lack of confidence, Azusawa, it's not holding your singing back in any way as far as I can see.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You're never satisfied with just what is either and you have developed an incredible work ethic as a result.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, you really have.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Your singing is awesome and you know how to work the crowd. I say you have nothing to worry about right now.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thanks, everyone...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But still...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Why does it feel like what that man said isn't entirely wrong...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? Was he someone from the biz?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I'm not sure...
But he did seem to know quite a bit about RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
By the way, what did he look like?
We could try looking for him if he's a regular around here!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I wanna hear more about what he has to say, and we might even be able to get some clearer answers for you, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, right...!
Thanks, An!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So what was he like?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Well... He was pretty tall, seemed a little scary at first and had a cool, low voice...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, An, I thought he was a lot like your dad too!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: My dad?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. That was the biggest impression I took away.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Someone like dad? There's really only one person that comes to mind...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But there's no way he could be here...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Uh, no. It's nothing.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I'll try asking around to see if anyone's seen the person you described to us, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thank you so much, An!
You're a lifesaver!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You're welcome!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Still...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Kohane's been doing great lately. Why isn't she having more confidence in herself?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Alright...
That should be enough for today.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I've got work soon, so I gotta go.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay, cool!
You said you were busy after this too, right, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. The library committee asked me to make a list of all the books we just received.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, okay.
That sounds like a ton of work, but a little fun at the same time.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, it really is.
What are your plans after this, Azusawa, Shiraishi?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I... I think I'll stay and practice some more.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay, but don't push yourself too hard.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I promise not to. How about you, An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, I think I'll stick around and practice too... We can work on stuff together, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Later.
Make sure you're not late tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
We know!
See you!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Phew...
I might be feeling more tired than usual...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You literally just did a gig, so a break might not be a bad idea.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay. How about we go to Weekend Garage?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Sure, but...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Mind if we chat for a bit?  Over there maybe?
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hello!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, An, Kohane. Welcome.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hm? Are Miku and the others not here today?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: No, Miku ran off somewhere. Len and Rin also went off to go do something with KAITO too. Thus, the quietness, but feel free to stay as long as you like.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Haha. Okay!
Looks like we have no choice but to take up her offer, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The usual?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yes, please!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Okay.
Coming right up.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That reminds me, I didn't get to finish saying what I thought about your event today. It was so good.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: The crowd was on edge before started singing and it was like you cast a spell on them after you did!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yes, really! It's like they were all waiting for you to do your thing!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I didn't realize that, but I'm glad everyone enjoyed it so much.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Seriously, I couldn't be prouder of my partner!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You reminded me that you really are the best partner I could ask for!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe... You're exaggerating

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You know I'm not kidding, right...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm proud to be your partner, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But that's not the whole story. Akito, Toya and everybody on Vivid Street know what you're capable of now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Today was proof of that too, you know?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I get that you're still a little bothered by what other people say about you...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But it's totally okay for you to have more confidence in yourself!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah. You're right, An.
Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Then... Can I ask you something, An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Sure! What's up?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: How do I do that...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No matter how much I practice, it never feels right...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: How to be more confident, huh...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I've never actually thought about that. I always assumed that you just do after you work really hard on something...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmm... How does it actually work?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's a tough conversation it sounds like you're having there.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Here's your cafe au lait.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Would you like anything else...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hmm... Being more confident in yourself...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Have you ever done anything that made you genuinely feel confident about yourself before, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um... Maybe...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: With exams, I'm always anxious about how they'll go and even how they went afterward...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I've never had trouble when it comes to taking care of Count Pearl, but I'm not sure that counts...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, guiding everyone around Phoenix Wonderland...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But that's just me talking about a place I really like, so I'm not sure that counts either...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Then... What about when you were little? I'm sure there's something you did back then that made you feel proud of yourself, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: When I was little...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Maybe less so. I don't remember doing anything noteworthy back then...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I do remember a time when I tried to climb a tree with a friend...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You went tree climbing?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes. Everybody else kept climbing higher and higher...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
But I couldn't.
I was so worried about what would happen if I fell, or not be able to climb back down.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: They just kept going up and up, while I stayed at the bottom too scared to do anything...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
It happened a lot too.
Playing tag, trying to pet my neighbor's dog... None of it went well for me.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: My friends back then even kept saying, It's okay, Kohane. Don't worry about it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Is that why I'm always looking up to and trying to be as good as someone else...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Have I been standing at the bottom of that tree this entire time...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No, you're wrong!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: There's still a lot that I don't know about you, Kohane, but I know that you're an amazing singer.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So quit getting yourself down like that.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thanks, An.

rows.Line: Aww... C'mon, dad...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'd like some more too, so why don't we go together?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really? Alright, back to the counter!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay. That should be enough rice.
Now to cover it in plenty of curry...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An, thank you...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I was able to stand proud and sing today.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And it's all because you said that you believe in me, An.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So I can't thank you enough!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (But why...?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Kohane figured out how to sing way better than she usually does, and I was so happy to see it happen...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (It was the most exciting moment we've had so far singing together...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (But... Why...?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Why do I have this knot in my chest?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Uh, sorry! It's nothing, really...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Kohane...
You were able to sing like that because you were able to find the answer yourself.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, congratulations!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I don't know what this feeling is...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I'm happy, more than happy that Kohane's finally smiling again. There's absolutely no denying how I feel about what happened, so...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I'll keep doing my best!
Let's find a way to surpass RAD WEEKEND together!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Don't worry! We will!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And in order to do that, you'll need to dig in and start building up your strength!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What? B-But I can't eat all this...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hahaha. I'm joking! But here's yours.
Wanna head back now?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay!
